北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感舒适。外出记得多补充水分哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and feels comfortable. Remember to hydrate when you're out!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波多云，体感闷热。记得多喝水，防暑降温！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy and muggy. Remember to drink water and cool down!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感闷热，湿度大。记得开空调，保持凉爽！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels muggy with high humidity. Remember to use AC and stay cool!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州高温酷热，体感 37℃。务必防暑，避免中暑！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is extremely hot, feeling like 37℃. Be sure to prevent heatstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感炎热，紫外线强。出门做好防晒，多补水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels hot with strong UV. Use sunscreen and hydrate when you go out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州天气炎热，午后注意防晒。多喝水哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is hot, watch out for sun in the afternoon. Drink plenty of water!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感稍热，记得适时补水。保持好心情！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels a bit hot, remember to hydrate in time. Keep a good mood!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感微热。出门带伞，以防万一！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feeling a bit warm. Bring an umbrella just in case!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉炎热，体感 35℃。注意防晒防暑，多喝水！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is hot, feeling like 35℃. Protect from sun and heat, drink water!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天闷热，体感 35℃。注意防暑，多补充水分。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and muggy, feeling like 35℃. Prevent heatstroke and hydrate.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆高温，体感 39℃！务必防暑降温，避免长时间暴晒。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is hot, feeling like 39℃! Be sure to cool down and avoid long sun exposure.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感舒适。湿度稍高，保持清爽！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and comfortable. Humidity is a bit high, stay fresh!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，湿度较高。出门带件薄外套，以防着凉！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy with high humidity. Bring a light jacket to avoid catching a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感舒适。风力稍大，注意防风保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and comfortable. Wind is a bit strong, mind the wind and stay warm.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天潮湿，体感闷热。注意除湿，保持干爽！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and humid, feeling muggy. Dehumidify and stay dry!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感微热。海边游玩注意防晒，小心海风！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feeling a bit warm. If by the sea, use sunscreen and mind the sea breeze!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感稍热。出门记得多补水，保持活力！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feeling a bit hot. Remember to hydrate and stay energized!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦小雨，湿度 96%。出门带伞，地面湿滑注意安全。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu has light rain, 96% humidity. Bring an umbrella, watch out for slippery roads.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云闷热，湿度高。注意防暑，多饮水！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and muggy with high humidity. Watch out for heatstroke and drink more water!
